name: @capyup/pi-exa
description: Exa web research for pi via five first-class tools + skill + local CLI. Uses the official exa-js SDK directly — no MCP server, no adapter. Tools: exa_search, exa_similar, exa_fetch, exa_answer, exa_research. Supports real-time livecrawl, subpage extractio
